variables.name: age_at_draw
variables.label: Age at blood draw
variables.definition: Age computed from full-year birth dates and the index blood-collection date.
variables.headline: Median 64.1 years · IQR 57.0–70.6
variables.title: Age at blood draw
variables.note: Five-year bins include all adults. Eligibility uses completed calendar age; no individual dates are shown.

variables.name: sex_name
variables.label: Recorded sex
variables.definition: Recorded demographic field, harmonized for the analysis.
variables.headline: Recorded sex
variables.title: Recorded sex
variables.note: Unknown values remain explicit. Recorded race is not a measure of genetic ancestry.

variables.name: race_group
variables.label: Race group
variables.definition: Recorded demographic field, harmonized for the analysis.
variables.headline: Race group
variables.title: Race group
variables.note: Unknown values remain explicit. Recorded race is not a measure of genetic ancestry.

variables.name: smoking_group
variables.label: Smoking history
variables.definition: Recorded demographic field, harmonized for the analysis.
variables.headline: Smoking history
variables.title: Smoking history
variables.note: Unknown values remain explicit. Recorded race is not a measure of genetic ancestry.

variables.name: primary_cancer_site
variables.label: Recorded tumor group
variables.definition: Registry-prioritized primary malignant solid-tumor site; this is descriptive context, not an eligibility rule.
variables.headline: Recorded tumor group
variables.title: Recorded tumor group
variables.note: All groups, including unknown and melanoma, are retained. Assignment prioritizes registry records, pre-draw timing, and proximity to blood collection.

variables.name: ch_group
variables.label: Clonal hematopoiesis category
variables.definition: Mutually exclusive classification from variants retained by the primary quality filters.
variables.headline: Any retained CH: 41.1%
variables.title: Clonal hematopoiesis category
variables.note: Low-VAF only: 0.3%≤VAF<2%, with no retained variant ≥2%. Conventional CHIP: any retained variant ≥2%; this is an operational VAF category without cohort-wide hematologic adjudication.

variables.name: clinical_record_coverage
variables.label: Linked clinical record coverage
variables.definition: Unique eligible participants with at least one row in each source table.
variables.headline: Linked clinical record coverage
variables.title: Linked clinical record coverage
variables.note: Coverage groups overlap. Absence of an event-table row is not proof that the event did not occur.

variables.name: variant_gene
variables.label: Retained variants by gene
variables.definition: Gene annotations on the retained CH variant records.
variables.headline: DNMT3A and TET2 are the most frequent genes
variables.title: Retained variants by gene
variables.note: All genes observed in this release are displayed. Variant counts are not participant counts.

variables.name: variant_allele_frequency
variables.label: Variant VAF strata
variables.definition: Retained variants classified using their own VAF.
variables.headline: Variant VAF strata
variables.title: Variant VAF strata
variables.note: A participant can carry variants in both strata. VAF is not a direct measurement of clone size.

variables.name: retained_variant_status
variables.label: Retained CH status
variables.definition: At least one retained variant after supplied alternate-read, recurrence and panel-of-normals flag exclusions.
variables.headline: 9,904 participants with retained CH
variables.title: Retained CH status
variables.note: Denominator membership defines sequencing eligibility; variant-row absence alone does not indicate sequencing failure.

variables.name: sequencing_depth
variables.label: Sequencing depth
variables.definition: Median depth for retained variants; in the no-CH group, median of participant-specific medians from selected historical unfiltered records.
variables.headline: Sequencing depth
variables.title: Sequencing depth
variables.note: Low-VAF median 2,972.5× (IQR 2,467–3,516); ≥2% median 2,664.5× (IQR 2,083.25–3,201.75). No-CH depth is available for 14,213 people and uses a different summary unit.

variables.name: alternate_reads
variables.label: Alternate-supporting reads
variables.definition: Median alternate-read count per retained variant.
variables.headline: Alternate-supporting reads
variables.title: Alternate-supporting reads
variables.note: Alternate-read support does not establish a validated assay limit of detection.

variables.name: observed_followup_years
variables.label: Observed follow-up
variables.definition: Time from blood collection to verified death or last valid contact.
variables.headline: Median 5.71 years
variables.title: Observed follow-up range
variables.note: Data-review cutoff: 16 September 2026. One invalid endpoint is omitted; no contact date is imputed.

variables.name: vital_status
variables.label: Overall-survival status
variables.definition: Observed endpoint status in the survival analysis.
variables.headline: 8,280 observed deaths
variables.title: Overall-survival status
variables.note: One participant without a valid endpoint is excluded from survival estimation, not from the full cohort.

variables.name: last_contact_available
variables.label: Valid follow-up endpoint
variables.definition: Valid death or contact endpoint on or after blood collection, evaluated through 16 September 2026.
variables.headline: Valid follow-up endpoint
variables.title: Valid follow-up endpoint
variables.note: The invalid endpoint is not assumed to represent censoring.

variables.name: registry_postdraw_hm
variables.label: Post-draw hematologic registry records
variables.definition: Primary malignant hematologic registry records dated after blood collection through the review cutoff.
variables.headline: 126 participants with candidate records
variables.title: Post-draw hematologic registry records
variables.note: These are candidate outcomes, not adjudicated incident malignancies. A recorded date can reflect first contact rather than disease onset.
